Notice to Residents: Bin Collection

General waste and recycling are collected every Thursday morning. Bins must be out by 7am and brought back in by the evening.

Garden waste is collected every other Monday for residents who have paid the annual fee of 45 pounds.

Overcrowded or overflowing bins will not be emptied. Extra bags can be taken to the tip on Mill Lane.
